Synthetic project id. Split train/test BY project (see split) so no project leaks across sets
Licence-pool group of ~20 projects that share the same licences (random business-unit grouping). Splits are made by portfolio
train / validation / test (~70/15/15), assigned per PORTFOLIO so no portfolio (and its shared history) crosses sets
Per-project weight (mean 1): every project counts equally in training; pass as sample_weight. Long projects otherwise dominate (6 to 228 rows per project)
Software id SW001-SW008. Name, category, price and owned licences: lookups/software_lookup.csv
Owning department of the project
Low / Medium / High

How many of the 8 tools the project uses

Planned deadline
Planned project length in months (2-12)
Date the prediction is made (start of project-month c+1); only info before this date is used in features
c = months of the project already completed at prediction time (0 = plan-only / cold start)
deadline_months - months_elapsed_at_cutoff

Project-month being predicted (= c + h)
Calendar start date of the predicted month
Calendar month 1-12 of the predicted month (seasonality / holidays)
Working days in the predicted month

1 if predicted month is the last planned month before the deadline

Planned dominant phase in the predicted month (known from the plan)
Planned phase intensity 0-1 of that phase
Planned load = team size x phase intensity x software-phase affinity x need weight (avg over working days)
Planned max concurrent users in the predicted month (planner estimate, not actual demand)
Licences owned for this software (licence_inventory.csv); needed to read shortage/idle targets
Peak licences used by the project for this software in last observed month (blank when c=0)
Highest monthly peak observed so far (blank when c=0)
Mean of monthly peaks observed so far (blank when c=0)
Last month peak minus the month before (blank when c=0, 0 when c=1)
Observed usage divided by planned load so far - shows if the team uses more/less than planned (blank when c=0)
Peak concurrent licences the project needs for this software in the predicted month (incl. unmet demand)
target_licences_required x monthly price (annual/12), INR
Average of daily peak concurrent licences in the predicted month
Highest planned daily load in the predicted month (team x phase intensity x affinity x need weight)

Number of different phases inside the predicted month (a phase change = ramp up/down)
Planned load of the last observed month (blank when c=0)

Planned load of predicted month minus last observed month = planned ramp (blank when c=0)
obs_peak_per_plan_load_last x plan_load_index_target = quick estimate of the target peak; capped at 30 (blank when c=0)
Max number of OTHER portfolio projects planned to use this software on a day of the predicted month
Planned load of all portfolio projects on this software in the predicted month (own + others)
Planned load of the other portfolio projects only
Peak licences the whole portfolio used on this software in the 30 days BEFORE the cut-off (known history, no leakage)
Same, last 90 days before the cut-off
Peak licences the whole portfolio needs on this software in the predicted month (sum of project peaks x 0.85 coincidence factor when >1 project)
Months from the cut-off to the next annual renewal of this software (licence_inventory.csv renewal date). Context for buy/temporary decisions; does not drive demand
1 if the predicted month falls after the next renewal (a feature, despite the name)
licences_owned - portfolio_peak_last_30d (negative = pool was exceeded)
portfolio_planned_load_target / licences owned = planned pressure on the pool
max(0, target_portfolio_peak_demand - licences_owned) = licences missing
1 if the pool is exceeded in the predicted month (~15% of rows)
Months from the predicted month to the deadline = how long the licences would be needed. >= 7.5 -> buying annually is cheaper than temporary
Lower of: buy annually (licences x annual price) or temporary until deadline (licences x temporary monthly price x months_need_from_target_to_deadline), INR
Cheapest cost of covering the shortage: min(buy annual, temporary until deadline) x shortfall licences, INR
max(0, licences_owned - portfolio peak) x monthly price = monthly cost of owned licences not needed, INR
Low(0-2) / Medium(3-5) / High(6+) from target_licences_required (zero-need merged into Low: only 0.04% of rows)
